device.subtitle: Connection, pairing & dual-host management
device.pair.hint: Press the device button to confirm during pairing; if the device is already bound to another host, press an enrolled fingerprint first, then the button.
device.dual.desc: A device can bind up to two hosts. Use the device's switch fingerprint to toggle between them.
fp.title: Fingerprint management
fp.auth.desc: For unlock and authorization, up to 5 (slots 0-4).
fp.switch.desc: Dedicated to switching between two hosts (slot 5); not used for unlock. Once enrolled, press this fingerprint on the device to switch to the other host.
keys.title: Key store
keys.subtitle: On-device SSH / TOTP / API keys - private keys never leave the device
keys.totp.desc: Reading a code requires a fingerprint touch.
keys.ssh.desc: ECDSA P-256; signing happens inside the device.
keys.ssh.gen: Generate a new key on-device (fingerprint required)
ph.name: Name
setup.title: Setup
setup.pass.label: Login password
setup.pass.desc: Submitted to the system on unlock. Stored in Windows Credential Manager, never sent over BLE.
setup.cp.desc: After installation, the lock screen shows the immurok fingerprint-unlock tile. Importing the registry requires administrator rights (done by the installer).
setup.ssh.desc: When enabled, ssh / git sign with the device's SSH private key (each signature needs a fingerprint touch).
setup.ssh.note: First disable the built-in Windows ssh-agent (admin PowerShell): Stop-Service ssh-agent; Set-Service ssh-agent -StartupType Disabled
about.title: About
about.name: About immurok
about.desc: Bluetooth fingerprint authentication: unlock the screen by fingerprint, dual-host management, OTA firmware update. Screen unlock is built on a Credential Provider.
about.ota.desc: Pick a .imfw firmware package to update the device over the air. Do not disconnect the device during the update.
status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Whether each component is ready
setup.pass.hint: A Microsoft account sign-in name may differ from the local username; if unlock fails, re-save the password here using your sign-in email.
